description: This is a Java class named AdminController in a Spring MVC web application. It manages admin-related web requests for user management, including presenting forms for adding a new user and processing the form submissions.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administrator operations related to user management

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for adding a new user, populating model attributes with existing users, roles, and offices.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the submission of the new user form, validates input, saves the user, and returns success view.
